title: Personal notification settings and subscriptions UI
description: Where each person chooses what they receive and on which channels, shared across apps, plus the public subscribe flow for people with no account. Lucide icons, flat fills, no borders, buttons not dropdowns; screenshot review.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Readers' choices are per site, because pairwise subjects cannot be linked. Console and pages: PPY-17cf09, PPY-d7443d, PPY-ab9205. CLI: PPY-d99539. Rollout: PPY-dc8593.
